title: ID0425862-DC/Si-D/ES-[ Y2 / S0 313905922001 ] Charger freeze at 30%
description:
Reported issue: The charger is not running, freeze at 30% and reboot after several minutes. Customer is using ELMS via modbus and is not using yet an OCPP.
Solution: Configuration change in Router 2

additional_info.subject: ID0425862-DC/Si-D/ES-[ Y2 / S0 313905922001 ] Charger freeze at 30% CRM:00642002317
additional_info.body:
Dear Roberto,
Hope you are doing great.
As reported by you, the charger is stuck at 30%. Please refer to the steps below for troubleshooting:
1.Companion Tool and Computer Setup:
-
Use the Companion tool on your computer.
-Ensure that the computer is connected to the network.
2.Identify Missing IPs:
-Open Mobaxterm.
-Check for missing IP addresses in the network.
-Note down any devices that are not responding.
-Physically check all components.
-Verify LED indications on KF1 to KF9 — ensure all are green.
-Inspect all fuses — confirm they are in green condition.
3.Device Verification:
-Verify that the non-working devices are powered on.
-Check if LEDs are active on these devices.
4.Flash Devices:
-If power cycling doesn’t resolve the issue, use the Companion tool to flash the non-working devices.
-Follow the flashing process carefully.
5.CFAST Flash (if needed):
-If the issue persists, consider flashing the CFAST with LiveLinux.
-Refer to the appropriate documentation for this step.
Kindly refer to the attached knowledge article for information on this error.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425862-DC/Si-D/ES-[ Y2 / S0 313905922001 ] Charger freeze at 30% CRM:00642002317
additional_info.body:
Hello Mohini,
Today I was onsite checking the charger and finally I find a problem in configuration of router XF4 (Customer).
Now the charger run well but the HMI don’t show the chargers point to select. The charger has 2 CSS plug, no dispenser. I was checking in SCB and find that there was set an IP for LEM, but the charger has not LEM. I removed the LEM IP, then the LEDs pass from white to green but still not showing charger points for select. Could be it because the customer has not ready the OCPP yet? They are developing a system with their own OCPP and ELMS.
The charger is connected the 24Hrs Could you check the configuration? In another hand the firmware 7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a is download it and ready for install it, I didn’t installed because was searching the release note and not found it. Is it a firmware released? Or not.
Next 2 days I’ll working at 100 Km and if you need me onsite maybe the Thursday afternoon or Friday morning I could stop here again at my return to Madrid, 600Km from here.
THX
